title: SVG Viewer & SVG Preview (Zoom, PNG Export)
description: SVG viewer and SVG preview for VS Code: live preview beside the editor, zoom at the cursor and pan, viewBox outline, checkerboard or custom background, sprite sheet grid for <symbol>, .svgz, and PNG export at 1x to 8x. Scripts never run. Free, offline.

title: GeoJSON Viewer, KML Viewer & GPX Viewer (Map Preview, Shapefile)
description: GeoJSON viewer, KML viewer and GPX viewer with a map preview in VS Code. Also opens shapefiles (SHP, zipped), KMZ, TopoJSON, WKT and CSV with lat/lon: feature table, properties, GPX distance and elevation profile, reprojection from .prj, PNG export. Free, no sign-in, works offline.

title: VCD Viewer & Waveform Viewer (Verilog, No Signal Limit)
description: VCD viewer and waveform viewer for Verilog, SystemVerilog and VHDL simulations. Free with no signal limit: signal tree with search, cursor and two markers, bus grouping, hex, binary, signed and ASCII radix, and VCD files of 1 GB and more. A GTKWave-style viewer inside VS Code that works offline.

title: Craft Apps
description: Open the craft apps (PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft) from a craft-ai-hub in editor panels, and let Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or VS Code chat drive them over one local MCP server.

title: PCAP Viewer & PCAPNG Viewer (Packet Capture Analyzer)
description: PCAP viewer and PCAPNG viewer for VS Code: a packet capture analyzer with a packet list, protocol tree and linked hex pane, display filters, follow TCP stream, conversations and endpoints. Opens .pcap.gz and 1 GB captures. Pure JS, nothing to install (no Wireshark or sharkd). Free, no sign-in, works
